analysis.title: Macro Volatility Digest: No Contagion (Yet): Equity Vol Spikes, Macro Vol Fades
key_insights: Implied vols fell across most asset classes last week after Democrats swept Congress and US data beat expectations. Equities were the exception, with Tech selling off after the midterm election on fears of a pullback in AI investment.
The VIX gained 6 pts wk/wk to 25%, the richest cross-asset vol on a 1-year lookback and second richest on a 10-year lookback.

Rates, commodities, credit and FX implied vols all declined after the election, led by rates. The MOVE Index fell over 7 points as inflation expectations dropped on optimism that the Iran conflict is ending.
Brent fell below $100/bbl for the first time in two months.
FX vol is the cheapest cross-asset vol. USDJPY 1M implied vol fell 0.8 pt to near a 1-year low of 6.4%, which Cboe reads as a sign the price action was equity-specific rather than macro.
The VIX rose 11.5 pts last Thursday to a high of 28%, reversing its post-election decline, as the SPX fell over 4% on Tech weakness (QQQ -6.5%, SMH -11%).
Increases in put skew and put convexity accounted for 5.5 pts of the 11.5 pt VIX increase, more than the SPX spot move or the rise in SPX fixed strike vols.
SPX 1M skew (25-delta ratio) ended the week in the 93rd percentile and put convexity (10-delta/25-delta ratio) in the 99th percentile, as traders bid up tail protection.
Equity term structure is inverted across all the major indices. QQQ is the most inverted, with 1M vol at a 5 pt premium to 1Y vol.

Pain is concentrated in Tech: 5 of the 11 S&P sectors ended the week higher. COR1M rose only modestly to a high of 22% on Thursday, against an average near 70% over 20 years when the SPX falls 4% in a day.

Cboe reads the options market as pricing a rotation trade (AI vs. everything else) with little fear of contagion. The QQQ-SPX 1M implied vol spread widened to near record highs, while the RTY-SPX spread fell to near a multi-year low, which implies small caps are largely insulated from the AI trade.
In the table of weekly vol moves, QQQ 1M implied vol is 29.8 (+4.5 on the week, 99th percentile over 1Y) against 34.1 realized, EEM is 32.9 (+4.7) and SPX is 20.2 (+4.5, 93rd percentile).

sector_views.rationale: Tech sold off sharply on fears of a pullback in AI investment (QQQ -6.5%, SMH -11%). Options pricing shows elevated Tech risk, with the QQQ-SPX vol spread near record highs. Cboe describes market conditions and does not state a rating.
The RTY-SPX 1M vol spread fell to a near multi-year low, which implies small caps are largely insulated from the AI trade.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Richest cross-asset vol on a 1-year lookback and second richest on a 10-year lookback.
Rates vol led the decline across asset classes as inflation expectations fell on optimism that the Iran conflict is ending.
First time below $100 in two months, as oil sold off.
Fell 0.8 pt to near a 1-year low, which Cboe reads as a sign the equity sell-off was not a macro event.
A 'high' for the index but muted against the roughly 70% average implied correlation in past 4% SPX down days.

risk_factors: The AI-driven Tech sell-off could spread to the broader market. Cboe notes correlation is currently muted and the options market prices a rotation rather than contagion.
A further pullback in AI investment is the cited driver of the Tech sell-off.

tension_points.bull_case: The options market prices a rotation trade (AI vs. everything else) with little fear of contagion. COR1M is only 22%, 5 of 11 S&P sectors rose, and the RTY-SPX vol spread is near a multi-year low, so small caps are insulated.
tension_points.bear_case: The QQQ-SPX vol spread is near record highs, put skew and put convexity are at the 93rd and 99th percentiles, and equity term structure is inverted across all major indices. Cboe asks whether the AI sell-off will turn macro.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A sharp rise in implied correlation toward its roughly 70% historical average on 4% down days, or a widening of the RTY-SPX vol spread, would signal contagion. Cboe gives no specific level.
